paragraphs.text: The Harbour Café is looking for a weekend assistant to start in April. The job involves serving customers, preparing sandwiches and keeping the café clean. No experience is necessary, as full training will be given.
Hours are 8 am to 4 pm on Saturdays and Sundays, with a 30-minute lunch break. The pay is £11.50 per hour, and staff receive a free meal on each shift.
Applicants must be at least 18 years old. To apply, send a short letter explaining why you would like the job to the manager, Tom Price, by email. Interviews will be held in the second week of March.

The café is five minutes’ walk from the railway station, and staff can park without charge behind the harbour office. Please note that the café is closed from 24 December to 2 January. A black T-shirt and an apron will be provided, and staff should wear comfortable shoes.
